uiux.title: UI/UX Design
uiux.description: Designing clean and intuitive interfaces for websites and applications, from wireframes and layouts to polished prototypes.

graphic.title: Graphic Design
graphic.description: Creating visual materials such as posters, promotional graphics, social media content, product layouts, and other digital designs.

visual.title: Visual Design
visual.description: Working with typography, colors, layouts, imagery, and visual hierarchy to create designs that feel consistent and engaging.

approach.title: Understand
approach.description: I start by understanding the idea, purpose, audience, and problem that the design needs to solve.

approach.title: Plan
approach.description: I organize the content, structure, and user flow before moving into the visual design.

approach.title: Design
approach.description: I develop the visual direction through layouts, typography, colors, imagery, and interface elements.

approach.title: Refine
approach.description: I review the design, identify what can be improved, and refine the details to make the final result clearer and more polished.

approach.title: Deliver
approach.description: I prepare the final design and make sure it is ready for presentation, development, or actual use.
